title: Zesty Herbal Australian Ikura Pasta
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly Australian dish featuring ikura, herbs, and a bain-marie cooking method, perfect for a lazy Sunday lunch.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to package instructions.
In a small bowl, mix together the chopped parsley, dill, garlic, and lemon zest.
In a separate bowl, whip the ricotta cheese until it becomes light and aerated.
In a bain-marie, combine the whipped ricotta cheese, ikura, and herbal mixture, and stir gently over low heat.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the bain-marie, tossing everything together to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Drizzle the olive oil over the pasta and toss again to coat.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley and dill if desired.
